title: Civil Designer
content_text: Civil Designer, City of Busselton, Engineering and Facilities Services. Tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering or experience in civil design. Strong CAD skills (Microstation and 12D preferred). Pre-employment: C class licence, National Police Clearance, White Card, right to work. Enquiries Todd Della Bosca Senior Technical Officer Design (08) 9781 1729. Closes 4.30pm Monday 26 October 2026.
apply_instructions: Apply through the City of Busselton portal (click Apply); resume and brief letter
